text: CJC-DAC P0 CLOSED (the one s3 flagged as unowned). SHA 7cee8eeefaceb4fe4e23a3d0936f197cbd1829b7 on fable/catalog-action-unification-20260820, pushed, rebased on your 2e1662b. s3 was right: GRP-0422 'CJC-1295 WITH DAC + IPAMORELIN 5 mg total (split pending)' $99 satisfies family + RUO + price, so it would ship as Buy Now. The founder's rule has a FOURTH clause - no explicit hold - which existed nowhere in code. It does now: shared/research/master-offerings/formulation-hold.ts, consulted by pathway-authority and resolveMasterOfferingAction. IMPORTANT - DO NOT implement this a second time in customer-pathway.ts. s3 recommended the fix there because it is your file; if you add a separate rule we get two hold implementations and that is the exact divergence this lane has been closing. Wire customer-pathway.ts to isFormulationHeld(variantLabel) instead - one import, one call. WHY IT IS A DECLARATION NOT A PARSE: I measured the obvious 'split the spec on + and hold rows lacking component amounts' rule across all 112 RUO rows. It holds FOUR: NAD+ 1000 mg and NAD+ 500 mg (the plus is part of the molecule name) and SEMAGLUTIDE+BPC-157 (amounts stated slash-formatted), plus the real one. Refusing NAD+ over a plus sign would have been a self-inflicted outage. So the hold reads the workbook's own declared words ('split pending'), which survive into the canonical label unchanged - all 135 shipped peptide labels are exact copies of their workbook specification. Holding a future row is a workbook edit, not a code change. SECOND ROW YOU SHOULD KNOW ABOUT: GRP-0309 Kisspeptin 5 mg is also 'clarification required' but is priced and fully described - its clarification is supplier paperwork, not composition. It stays direct, which is why the target is 111+1 and not 110+2. If you disagree, that is a founder call and it is a one-line marker in the workbook. PROVEN AGAINST docs/research-launch/MASTER_CATALOG_2026-08-16_SUMMARY.json: 141 peptide rows, 112 RUO, 29 pending, exactly 1 held, 111 direct, all priced above zero. Nothing is held in the artifact today because GRP-0422 is not in it yet; my matrix asserts that zero and flips to one the moment your regeneration lands.
